findings.issue: Hophal imperfect 3ms (be put to death) is rendered as simple morirá, changing stem force from passive causation to intransitive death.
Common noun אדם is left untranslated as adam; common nouns stay Spanish.
de is grammatical smoothing linking each hiphil participle to its direct-object noun; the packet has no preposition.

notes: Y, both hiriente, bestia, and la pagará (piel 3ms + 3fs suffix) match the remaining tokens.
